changeSet.author: hellodata
changeSet.comment: Add quarter column to dashboard_comment table so the relevant quarter can be set manually

changeSet.author: hellodata
changeSet.comment: Backfill quarter of existing comments from their creation date
changeSet.sql: UPDATE dashboard_comment SET quarter = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM (to_timestamp(created_date / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Zurich')) WHERE quarter IS NULL
